analysis: Examined the changed provider-swift code. In ProviderLoop+InferenceHandler.swift the diff is two call-site renames, autopilotAllowsModel to autopilotServesModel, at the throwIfRefusingNewLocalWork gate (~line 135) and the authoritative pre-accept check (~line 513). The supplied head text (lines 620-1556) is unchanged context. It still fails closed on encryption errors: both response-key setup and per-chunk emitSSE failures send an encryptionFailure terminal with no plaintext fallback (T-008). Cancellation, billing-floor and usage-recovery logic is unchanged. The prefix-cache receipt and usage paths (T-041) are unchanged. In ProviderLoop+ModelLoading.swift, the load guard switches to autopilotServesModel and still permits a load that matches the owning autopilot command. unloadModel now calls reconcileAutopilotPlacements() immediately after the slot is removed and before the awaits. evictableModelSlots additionally excludes slots where autopilotHoldsModel is true, which only narrows eviction. No new input surface, crypto, attestation, key or disk change. Unverified: the definitions of autopilotServesModel, autopilotHoldsModel and reconcileAutopilotPlacements are outside the supplied evidence. I cannot confirm that autopilotServesModel is at least as strict as autopilotAllowsModel. Nor can I confirm that the adopted/held placement semantics cannot admit non-selected models, or that holds are released so the eviction exclusion cannot starve slot-cap or memory admission (DoS, T-029/T-010 class). The ModelLoading patch excerpt is truncated after the evictableModelSlots hunk; the range map is complete. Integration should check those helper implementations and their callers for ordering and actor re-entrancy. No concrete regression is supported by the visible code.
